title: EXCLUSIVE: Himesh Reshammiya to compose music for Veer Pahariya’s Naam - To Live Is War; reunites with Mahesh Bhatt after 16 years
raw_summary:
One of the most awaited films of 2027, Naam - To Live Is War, has just got bigger. Presented by Mahesh Bhatt, the film was announced in June and stars Veer Pahariya in the lead. Varun Sharma of Fukrey fame will be seen playing a negative role for the first time in his career. Last week, the makers announced that Prashant Narayanan, Vijayant Kohli and Shefali Bagga had joined the cast. Now, Bollywood Hungama has exclusively learned that another prominent name has come on board – Himesh Reshammiya.

A source told Bollywood Hungama, “Naam - To Live Is War is an intense film and the makers wanted someone who could do musical justice to its subject and theme. They felt Himesh Reshammiya would be the right choice. Himesh was impressed with the film's plot and the passion of the team and hence, he readily came on board. He was also excited about collaborating with Mahesh Bhatt after a long time.”

Interestingly, Himesh Reshammiya and Mahesh Bhatt go back a long way. Himesh composed the song 'Soorat Pe Teri Pyar Aave' for Footpath (2003), starring Aftab Shivdasani and Emraan Hashmi. Mahesh Bhatt was associated with the film as a writer. Later, Mahesh Bhatt wrote the story and screenplay of Kajraare (2010), which starred Himesh Reshammiya in the lead. Himesh also composed and sang all the songs of the film.

Naam - To Live Is War, hence, marks their reunion after nearly 16 years. Although they haven't collaborated during this period, the mutual respect has remained intact. After the release of Himesh Reshammiya's 2014 mystery thriller The Xposé, he revealed in an interview with The Times of India that Mahesh Bhatt had personally called to congratulate him. Himesh had said, “Bhatt sahab called to congratulate me and that was an emotional moment for me. His praise means a lot.”

Himesh Reshammiya is on a roll. Besides Naam - To Live Is War, he has several interesting films in his pipeline, including Sooraj Barjatya's Yeh Prem Mol Liya, the Emraan Hashmi-starrer Gunmaaster G9, Anil Sharma's Arjun Naga and Vikram Bhatt's horror film, 1920: Cold Winter.

The source further revealed, “Like these upcoming films, the music rights of Naam - To Live Is War have also been acquired by Himesh Reshammiya's music label, Himesh Reshammiya Melodies.”

Coming back to Naam - To Live Is War, the film is presented by Mahesh Bhatt under Utsav Entertainment and Productions. Directed by Sidhaant Sachdev, it is produced by Utsav Upadhyay and Riddhi Chawda.

Naam - To Live Is War marks Veer Pahariya's third film after the Akshay Kumar-Sara Ali Khan co-starrer Sky Force (2025) and the recently released romantic comedy Prem Keetanu (2026).

title: Bombay High Court directs makers of Tu Hai Meri Kiran to deposit Rs. 8.85 crores before release
raw_summary:
The Bombay High Court on Monday, October 19, ruled that Echelon Productions cannot commercially release or exploit Tu Hai Meri Kiran, starring Sonakshi Sinha and Zaheer Iqbal, unless it deposits Rs. 8.85 crores along with 15% annual interest to secure the investment made by co-producer AND Movie Products LLP, as per a report by Live Law Biz. The film is scheduled to release in theatres on October 23, 2026.

Justice Amit Borkar substantially allowed AND Movie Products LLP's petition seeking protection of its investment and contractual rights in the film. The Court observed that stopping the film's release entirely would disregard the money and effort invested in its production. However, it also said that the film should not be commercially exploited without securing the co-producer's investment.

The dispute stems from a co-production agreement signed on March 27, 2024, under which both parties agreed to contribute Rs. 7.50 crore each, plus GST, towards a film budget of Rs. 15 crores plus GST. AND Movie Products stated that it invested Rs. 8.85 crore between March 2024 and January 2025 but did not receive repayment as agreed.

Under the agreement, Echelon was required to repay the investment within 13 months of signing the contract or three weeks before the film's first release, whichever came earlier. The Court held that the repayment deadline expired on April 27, 2025, and the later announcement of the film's release date could not extend it.

The dispute escalated after a cheque for Rs. 7.50 crores issued by Echelon through Vishal Rana was dishonoured in January 2026. AND Movie Products subsequently approached the High Court after the film's October release was announced.

Echelon argued that repayment depended on the film's earnings and pointed to AND Movie Products' participation in Instagram promotions. However, the Court held that promotional activities did not waive the repayment obligation or remove the requirement for the co-producer's consent before third-party exploitation agreements could be signed.

The Court directed Echelon to deposit Rs. 8.85 crores, with 15% annual interest calculated from the respective investment dates, within three working days. If it fails to comply, the film cannot be commercially exploited.

Echelon must also disclose its existing and proposed exploitation agreements, maintain film revenues in a separate designated account and provide regular accounts. The company has been directed to obtain AND Movie Products' contractual consent before entering into exploitation agreements and correct or withdraw publicity credits that do not comply with the agreed producer credits.

The Court stated that the deposited amount would be held as security and could not be withdrawn without approval from the court or an arbitral tribunal. It declined to direct Vishal Rana to personally deposit the money at this stage, noting that the question of final liability would be settled through arbitration. The Bench also refused Echelon's request to put the judgment on hold.

title: Shanaya Kapoor's debut web show Student Of The Year: After Dark to premiere November 13 on JioHotstar
raw_summary:
JioHotstar has announced Student Of The Year: After Dark, a web series that reimagines the popular Student of the Year franchise in a darker format. Directed by Reema Maya and produced by Dharmatic Entertainment, the series will premiere exclusively on JioHotstar on November 13, 2026.

The announcement also marks Shanaya Kapoor’s OTT debut. The actor will be seen in a role that is markedly different from the glamorous campus setting associated with the earlier films in the franchise.

The first look introduces a darker world at St. Theresa, with the series moving away from the musical romance of the original films and towards a thriller-driven narrative.

 

View this post on Instagram

  A post shared by JioHotstar (@jiohotstar)

Alok Jain, Head – Hindi & English Entertainment Business (Streaming, TV & Studios), JioStar, “Student of the Year is a generational favourite, and reimagining an iconic franchise for a new format and a new generation comes with both responsibility and creative risk. Karan Johar created a world that became a defining part of youth culture, and with Student of the Year: After Dark, we have consciously chosen to take that legacy in a completely new direction, moving beyond what audiences may expect from the franchise and exploring a world that reflects how young India experiences stories today. It is an exciting creative leap, bringing back a familiar and much-loved IP in a completely new avatar, while retaining the spirit of what made it connect with audiences in the first place ”.

“When I look at this new chapter, I see a phoenix rising. We began this franchise with big dreams in 2012, and now we’re breaking every rule we set. With Reema’s genre-defying direction and Shanaya’s powerful double-role performance, we’re setting the stage for something spectacular. Shanaya isn’t just stepping into the spotlight; she’s shattering it, and the first look is just the tip of the iceberg”, said Karan Johar, Founder & Managing Director of Dharmatic Entertainment.

“At Dharmatic, we champion stories that evolve with the times, and finding a partner like JioHotstar, who shares that creative ethos, is nothing short of remarkable. Our upcoming project, Student of the Year: After Dark Web Series, is a testament to this shared vision. It’s not just a reboot, but a bold, genre-defying reimagining for a new generation”, said Apoorva Mehta, CEO & Managing Director for Dharmatic Entertainment.

Director of the series, Reema Maya, who is lauded for her daring narratives, brings her signature realism to this high-gloss world. “This isn’t going to be what you expect. It is Student Of The Year, stripped to its bones and reimagined as a thriller competition web series. Karan Johar has put his faith in my voice and vision, and I’m excited to have fun with this genre. The web series format is giving us a wide canvas for the conversations we want to have with our youth. We had so much fun with the music of the show. The cast is young and incredibly talented! Shanaya is a director’s actor - prepared and hardworking.”

“Student Of The Year: After Dark Web Series for me is more than just a project; it’s a bold statement. Portraying this character in a contrasting manner is a deliberate choice to challenge expectations and redefine what audiences anticipate from mainstream storytelling. The role is layered, flawed, and unapologetically real. Stepping into her world has been the most challenging and a rewarding experience”, says the enigmatic Shanaya Kapoor.

title: After a soaring festival run, Sayani Gupta’s Aasmani heads to 5 more film festivals in next two weeks
raw_summary:
Sayani Gupta's directorial debut Aasmani is on a soaring Festival run. After winning at multiple festivals like iSAFF Vancouver, Atlanta, IFFSA Toronto, and Boston, and travelling to nine festivals in the past month alone, it's set to be screened at 5 more festivals in the next two weeks. The only Oscar Qualifyling south Asian festival Tasveer Film Festival in Seattle, Dharamshala International Film Festival, 55th Molodist Kyiv International Film Festival in Ukraine, 30th Vancouver Asian Film Festival and LA Femme International Film Festival, US, the film is playing at 12 festivals in 2 months.

It just played at the International Film Festival of South Asia (IFFSA) in Toronto. The film was an official selection, with Sayani winning the South Asian Screen Excellence Award. This also coincided with her birthday as she attended as the Guest of Honour and her Masterclass: Becoming a Star, Remaining an Actor moderated by Anup Singh Batla, director of Qissa and The Song of Scorpions with Irrfan Khan.

Sayani also won the Leadership award in Eccellence in Films at iSAFF Vancouver where Aasmani won Best film honourable mention Excellence in short Filmmaking.

It also won Best film at Atlanta Indian Film Festival and Best Director & Best Child actor in Boston. It played at 9 festivals last month, including the DC South Asian, Kerala IDSFFK, Tokyo International Short Film Festival, Bangalore International Short FF (Oscar-Qualifying), and Chicago South Asian Film Festival to name a few.

Aasmani has five more official selections lined up in the coming weeks, across the US, Canada, Ukraine and India.

First up is the 21st Tasveer Film Festival in Seattle, running from October 13 to 18. Tasveer is the world's only Oscar-qualifying South Asian film festival. Aasmani also played at BISFF Bangalore which is India's only Oscar Qualifying festival. After that, the film will screen at the 55th Molodist Kyiv International Film Festival in Ukraine, between October 24th and November 1. Right after, the film will also screen at the 22nd annual LA Femme International Film Festival, taking place from October 22 to 25 in Los Angeles. After Vancouver and Toronto, Aasmani is playing at a third festival in Canada: the 30th Vancouver Asian Film Festival (VAFF) from November 5-14th.

Sayani returns to India for the 15th Dharamshala International Film Festival, held from October 29 to November 1 at the Tibetan Children's Village in the Himalayan foothills.

With the film winning at almost every festival, while Sayani herself was honoured with the iSAFF (Vancouver) Leadership in Film Award and Screen Excellence at IFFSA, Toronto, it has been a busy year for the first-time writer/director, with more festival selections lined up till March 2027.

Aasmani is produced by Sayani Gupta Movies, Nikkhil Advani under Sumitra Gupta Foundation for Arts, and Dia Mirza and Ananya Rane under One India Stories.

title: Tiger Shroff Firing Incident: Three accused arrested by Kota police while travelling on Pune-Jaipur express
raw_summary:
Three men accused of being involved in the firing incident targeting Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff in Mumbai have been apprehended by the Kota City Police in Rajasthan. According to Kota Superintendent of Police Tejaswani Gautam, the three suspects were travelling on the Pune-Jaipur Express when the police team intercepted them. Two of the accused are from Haryana, while the third is from Bihar.

Speaking about the operation with ANI, Kota SP Tejaswani Gautam said the police received information about the suspects on Monday morning and acted swiftly to apprehend them. She said, "This morning, we received information, prompting us to activate our team. We learned that the three primary suspects involved in the firing were travelling by train and were due to arrive in Kota. Acting on this information, our team, within just 15 minutes, set a trap and thoroughly searched the entire train. Through this swift action by the Kota City Police, we have apprehended all three suspects responsible for the firing. We will soon hand the suspects over to the Mumbai Police. The names of these three individuals are: Rehan, alias Sukka, from Sonipat, Haryana; Hritik Kurmi, alias Roshan, from Begusarai, Bihar, who had been residing in Mumbai, Maharashtra, for the past few years; and one minor. We have apprehended and detained all three, and we will now hand them over to the Mumbai Police."

Gautam further explained that the police covered exit points, platforms and other locations to apprehend the suspects. The team received information at around 9:45 am, and the Mumbai Police have since arrived to take custody of the accused.

Providing details of the preliminary questioning, Gautam said, "Based on preliminary questioning, one of the accused is a Rapido rider. Further detailed interrogation will provide more clarity. The other two, one of whom is a minor and the other, Rehan, work as labourers in Sonipat. Preliminary questioning revealed that they intended to travel to Delhi by this train and then escape to Nepal from there. Rehan had previously been in contact with Anil Pandit..."

The firing incident took place at around 7 pm on Sunday when Tiger Shroff was leaving a football club in Mumbai's Juhu area. According to Mumbai Police, the accused allegedly opened fire at the actor's car. While Tiger escaped direct gunshot injuries, his driver sustained injuries in the incident.

Sources in the Mumbai Police Crime Branch indicated that the attack may have been planned after the accused monitored the actor's movements. The shooters allegedly knew that Tiger regularly visited the Juhu football ground on Sundays and had conducted reconnaissance before carrying out the attack. Following the firing, they reportedly travelled along SV Road through Vile Parle and Andheri, abandoned their motorcycle near Andheri West railway station and boarded a train towards Borivali. Preliminary intelligence suggested that the suspects subsequently crossed the Maharashtra border to evade law enforcement.

Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde visited Tiger's residence on Sunday night following the incident. He said the actor had sustained injuries to his left hand from gunpowder and glass fragments. Shinde also stated that Tiger and his mother, Ayesha Shroff, were shaken by the incident and assured them of the state government's support.

Speaking about the incident, Shinde said, "Strict action will be taken, and threats against public figures will not be tolerated."

Meanwhile, security outside Salman Khan's residence at Galaxy Apartments in Mumbai's Bandra area has been tightened following the firing incident. Police personnel wearing bulletproof jackets, along with police vehicles, were seen outside the actor's residence.

The case includes charges under Sections 109(1) and 3(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), along with Sections 3 and 25 of the Arms Act. The three suspects are expected to be handed over to the Mumbai Police for further investigation.

title: Imran Khan’s plea against ‘Leave India’ notice to be heard on October 26; Bombay High Court seeks Maharashtra government’s inclusion
raw_summary:
The Bombay High Court will hear actor Imran Khan’s petition challenging a directive issued by the Foreigners Regional Registration Office (FRRO) asking him to leave India on October 26. The actor has challenged the October 14 notice, arguing that it was issued without giving him a prior hearing and violated his rights as an Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) cardholder.

The matter was mentioned before a division bench comprising Chief Justice Mahesh Chandra Tripathi and Justice Advait Sethna on Monday. Senior advocate Venkatesh Dhond, appearing for Khan, told the court that the actor had received the notice after attempting to attend a protest, where he was stopped midway and had to return.

Dhond informed the bench that the Central government had been served a copy of the petition and requested an early hearing on October 21. However, the court scheduled the matter for October 26 to allow the FRRO time to obtain instructions on the petition.

During the hearing, the bench also asked Khan’s lawyers to implead the Maharashtra government as a party to the case so that the court could ascertain whether the actor had any criminal antecedents.

“Are there any criminal antecedents? Join State as party, so that in case. This is a local matter. So make State of Maharashtra a party,” the court said. Why Imran Khan challenged the FRRO notice In his petition, Khan has questioned the circumstances and manner in which the October 14 directive was issued. He has alleged that the authorities acted in haste without giving him an opportunity to present his case and bypassed the statutory protections available to him as an OCI cardholder. The actor has also claimed that the action followed social media campaigns targeting him by political figures.

According to the petition, the authorities issued the directive under public pressure rather than through an independent assessment of the circumstances. Khan has sought the quashing of the October 14 notice and an interim stay on its operation. He has also asked the court to restrain authorities from taking coercive steps, including deportation, issuing lookout notices, blacklisting him or interfering with his OCI status.

Additionally, the actor has sought the production of internal records relating to the decision to direct him to leave India. What led to the ‘Leave India’ notice? The directive was issued after Khan was briefly detained by the police following his participation in demonstrations against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

The notice came shortly after Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) leader Kirit Somaiya filed a first information report (FIR) at Mumbai’s Gamdevi police station, alleging public-order violations under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023.

Khan’s petition, filed on October 17, questions the speed with which the FRRO issued the directive following these developments. He has argued that the authorities failed to follow the procedure required before taking action that could affect his ability to remain in India. Imran Khan challenges notice, not OCI cancellation proceedings The actor’s petition also raises questions about the legal safeguards available to OCI cardholders. It argues that the FRRO bypassed Section 7D of the Citizenship Act, which provides for the cancellation of OCI registration on specified grounds and requires the prescribed procedure to be followed.

On October 17, the FRRO separately issued a show-cause notice asking Khan why his OCI registration should not be cancelled under Section 7D of the Citizenship Act. However, the actor has not challenged that notice in the present petition.

The distinction is significant because the October 14 directive asking him to leave India and the subsequent show-cause notice concerning his OCI registration are separate actions.

title: Imran Khan faces second FRRO notice as authorities initiate proceedings to revoke his OCI status
raw_summary:
The legal tussle over Imran Khan’s residency status in India has escalated, with the Foreigners Regional Registration Office (FRRO) in Mumbai issuing a second show-cause notice to the actor. The latest notice initiates proceedings to revoke his Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) registration and asks him to explain within 15 days why his status should not be cancelled.

According to official sources, the FRRO has sought a formal representation from Khan, following which the authorities will decide on the next course of action regarding his OCI privileges. The development comes days after the actor was served an exit directive asking him to leave India by October 28.

The matter reportedly stems from Khan’s participation in a peaceful demonstration at Mumbai’s August Kranti Maidan, where protesters gathered against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The FRRO has taken the position that foreign nationals are not permitted to participate in political rallies, agitations or demonstrations in India.

The notice identifies the 43-year-old actor as a US national and alleges violations of the Immigration and Foreigners Act, 2025, along with related rules and orders. The earlier directive had warned of possible legal action and prosecution under immigration laws if he failed to leave the country by the stipulated deadline.

Khan has challenged the departure order before the Bombay High Court through a writ petition. In his plea, he reportedly argued that the directive was issued without a prior inquiry, formal show-cause proceedings or an opportunity for a fair hearing.

His legal team has also highlighted his longstanding ties to India, arguing that the authorities had considered him primarily as a foreign national holding a US passport while overlooking his lifelong residency in the country and his status as an OCI cardholder. The petition further contends that the existing OCI guidelines do not expressly prohibit peaceful assembly in a personal capacity. Khan has sought an interim stay on the departure order.

The action has also prompted reactions from sections of the film industry and political circles. Filmmaker Kiran Rao, who has been associated with Khan’s family, was among those who reportedly questioned the measures taken against the actor, citing his longstanding connection to India.

With the FRRO now seeking an explanation on the proposed cancellation of his OCI registration, the next steps will depend on Khan’s response and the authorities’ subsequent decision. The legal challenge to the earlier exit directive remains a key part of the ongoing dispute.

title: Hanuman Ansh producer reveals film's EXACT budget for the FIRST time; also reveals that Haldiram invested Rs. 1.25 cr in the SLEEPER blockbuster
raw_summary:
Hanuman Ansh is currently in its tenth week and continues to pull in audiences. The devotional saga opened at just Rs. 10 lakhs and has gone on to collect nearly Rs. 322 crores and counting. What has stunned the trade, industry and movie buffs alike is that the film was reportedly made on a budget of just Rs. 2 crores. Hence, its return on investment (ROI) is historic, to say the least. In a recent interview, one of its producers, Namrata Singh, revealed for the first time the film's actual budget and a detailed break-up of its expenses. Interestingly, she also disclosed that Haldiram’s, the popular Indian snacks and sweets giant, had invested in the film.

Talking to The Economic Times, Namrata Singh said, “The film was made at a total cost of Rs 1.7 crore. Haldiram’s provided Rs 1.25 crore towards prints and advertising (P&A) as part of the co-production arrangement. Of the P&A budget, we spent approximately Rs. 65-70 lakhs on marketing, with the remaining amount going towards the release. We wanted to ensure that the film remained in theatres for three weeks, which involved an additional expenditure of over Rs. 40 lakhs. The overall expenditure, including production and P&A, was approximately Rs. 2.95 crore or close to Rs. 3 crore.”

She further said, “One of the film’s producers, Ragini Sona, is director Vishal Chaturvedi’s friend. They have known each other for a long time. They used to recite the Hanuman Chalisa together as part of a Hanuman club they ran. So, when we needed funding, Vishal approached her. She is an experienced producer. Her insights were valuable. When nobody else was willing to invest, Ragini offered to contribute Rs. 50 lakhs on the condition that someone else matched the amount. When no one came forward, I invested Rs. 50 lakhs from my mutual fund savings. That is how we managed to complete production.”

Namrata Singh added, “We needed additional funding for post-production. That is when Anupriya A Nagar, daughter of the UK-based financier Anshul Nagar, came on board as an investor, and she financed the post-production.”

She also said, “We had a shareholders' agreement. The arrangement was structured around the four of us, with each holding a 25% share in the IP, along with a three-year lock-in period and other agreed terms.”

title: Tiger Shroff Firing Incident: CM Devendra Fadnavis confirms that accused have been identified; assures that arrests will be made soon

Addressing the incident, the Chief Minister said, "This is a very serious and condemnable matter. The Mumbai Police have taken it with the utmost seriousness. They have obtained certain clues, based on which they are currently working, and specific individuals have already been identified. These people will be arrested very soon. Furthermore, we will track down their masterminds who remain in hiding and issue orders from afar. It is important to note that none of these individuals operate from within Maharashtra; those who do operate from within the state have already been arrested. These perpetrators are operating from outside Maharashtra, or even from outside the country. By coordinating with the states from which they operate, and with the assistance of the Central Government regarding those operating from abroad, we will track them down and take strict action against them. I reiterate: these are cowardly individuals. They attempt to strike from the shadows, but their efforts will be thwarted."

title: Dhurandhar and Ramayana have 2 parts each, but Anil Sharma goes FOUR steps ahead; confirms Arjun Naga will be a four-part saga
raw_summary:
Earlier, filmmakers would usually wait for a film to succeed before beginning work on its sequel. However, films like Baahubali and Pushpa changed this trend to an extent. In Bollywood, Dhurandhar was shot as one massive project before being split into two parts. Ramayana, meanwhile, has been envisioned as a two-part saga right from the beginning, even before the release of its first instalment. Now, Anil Sharma has gone not one or two, but four steps ahead! The filmmaker recently announced that his upcoming film, Arjun Naga, starring his son Utkarsh Sharma, will be a four-part entertainer.

According to a report in Mid-Day, Arjun Naga will be set against the backdrop of Dubai's oil rush in the 1960s. The story will explore the period surrounding the discovery of oil in the emirate's Fateh field in 1966, a landmark development that eventually helped transform Dubai from a modest fishing and trading hub into a global economic powerhouse.

A source told Mid-Day, “The story will begin when Dubai was still a small fishing and trading centre with dusty roads and simple homes. It will capture how an oil exploration concession was given to the Continental Oil Company in 1963, leading to years of drilling before oil was discovered. Arjun Naga will explore the fictional characters’ power dynamics against the emirate’s changing landscape and how their fortunes turned with the oil rush. Utkarsh’s character will rise from extreme poverty to become one of the richest men in Dubai.”

The article also carried a quote by Anil Sharma who confirmed, “Arjun Naga is about Dubai’s oil rush in the 1960s. We are making the film in four parts, and it will have 10-12 top actors in pivotal roles spread across these instalments. The title will change with each part. We will shoot in Mumbai, Rajasthan, other parts of India, Dubai, and other international cities.”

While Utkarsh Sharma plays the lead role, Arjun Rampal has been signed as the antagonist. Recently, it came to light that Randeep Hooda and Celina Jaitly have joined the period drama.

Bollywood Hungama had exclusively revealed in August 2026 that Himesh Reshammiya has been signed to compose the music for Arjun Naga.

title: EXCLUSIVE: Ayushmann Khurrana-Sara Ali Khan starrer Udta Teer DENIED release permission in Nepal

Bollywood Hungama has learned that Udta Teer has not been granted permission for public screening in Nepal. Bollywood Hungama is in possession of a copy of the official order, which was communicated to the makers by Bishal Bhandari, Section Officer, Ministry of Communication and Information Technology, Government of Nepal.

The letter further stated that permission was denied as the film falls under the subject matter prohibited by Section 5(3) of the Film (Production, Exhibition and Distribution) Act, 2026 B.S.

The letter was issued on Ashwin 30, 2083, as per Nepal's Bikram Sambat calendar, which corresponds to Friday, October 16, 2026, in the Gregorian calendar.

Udta Teer stars Ayushmann Khurrana, Sara Ali Khan, the late Mukul Dev and several others. Written and directed by Akash A Kaushik, the film is produced by Karan Johar, Adar Poonawalla and Apoorva Mehta's Dharma Productions, along with Guneet Monga Kapoor and Achin Jain's Sikhya Entertainment.

The film tells the story of a Pakistani spy who infiltrates India but ends up losing his memory. In an unexpected turn of events, he begins believing that he is a hardcore Indian patriot, leading to chaos and madness.

title: Tiger Shroff Shooting Incident: Mumbai Police register FIR against 3 unknown accused, form 15 teams to trace shooters
raw_summary:
The Mumbai Police have registered an FIR against three unidentified accused in connection with the firing incident targeting Tiger Shroff in Juhu on Sunday evening, October 18. Meanwhile, the police have also formed 15 specialised investigation teams to identify and track down those involved in the incident.

According to a statement from the Mumbai Police given to ANI, the FIR has been registered under Sections 109(1) and 3(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), along with Sections 3 and 25 of the Arms Act. The police confirmed that an investigation is underway to establish the identities of the accused.

The incident took place near Pushpa Narsee Park in Juhu when Shroff was reportedly returning from a football session in his car. According to preliminary reports, unidentified armed men arrived on a motorcycle and fired multiple rounds at his vehicle before fleeing the scene.

The actor reportedly escaped direct bullet injuries, although some reports suggested he sustained minor abrasions from shattered glass. His driver, identified in reports as Firdosh, suffered a bullet injury to his left arm. An autorickshaw driver in the vicinity was also injured in the firing.

Both injured individuals were rushed to Nanavati Hospital in Vile Parle for medical attention. Reports indicated that the driver was stabilised and kept under medical observation. Further details about the condition of both injured individuals have not been independently confirmed.

Following the shooting, police officials cordoned off the area while forensic teams examined the scene and collected empty shell casings and other potential evidence. The investigation teams are reportedly examining CCTV footage, tracing possible escape routes and conducting technical surveillance to identify the shooters.

Investigators are also examining whether the assailants had monitored the actor’s movements before the incident. Additionally, the police are looking into an unverified social media message purportedly linked to associates of the Lawrence Bishnoi syndicate. The claim remains unverified, and the police have not established a motive for the shooting.

The incident also prompted a response from Maharashtra’s political leadership. Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis reportedly contacted the Mumbai Police Commissioner and directed the force to investigate the case swiftly. Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde later visited Shroff’s residence to check on the actor.

With an FIR now registered against three unknown accused and 15 teams reportedly involved in the investigation, the Mumbai Police are continuing to examine forensic evidence, CCTV footage and other leads to establish the sequence of events and identify those responsible.
